			local function u595(p101)

					end)

							u656 = v
							u657 = TextLabel32

									u258 = nil

									local g1484 = nil

									local g1488 = nil

		local connection = nil
		local u105 = v103
		local u106 = v101

		connection = Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)

		local spawn = task.spawn
